title: Inbox Unread Debt Trend
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=inbox:stats
| timechart span=1w avg(unread_count) as unread
| eventstats avg(unread) as baseline
| eval debt_rising=if(unread>baseline*1.2,1,0)
description: Tracks whether inbox backlog is quietly turning into permanent unread debt.
value: Unread debt is not just clutter; it is a personal attack surface for missed receipts, notices, and security mail.
implementation: Send weekly inbox statistics to `index=personal`; chart unread counts and compare them with baseline.
visualization: Weekly line chart of unread-count trend with rising-debt flag.
grandmaExplanation: It watches whether unread email is quietly piling up into a backlog that never really gets cleared.
